def win(L,r0,r1,c0,c1):
    return tuple(tuple(1 if L[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c1)) for r in range(r0,r1))
def trim(g):
    rs=[r for r in range(len(g)) if any(g[r])]; cs=[c for c in range(len(g[0])) if any(g[r][c] for r in range(len(g)))]
    return tuple(tuple(g[r][c] for c in range(cs[0],cs[-1]+1)) for r in range(rs[0],rs[-1]+1))
def rot90(g):
    n=len(g); return tuple(tuple(g[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)) for r in range(n))
def dih(g):
    seen=[]; cur=g
    for _ in range(4):
        if cur not in seen: seen.append(cur)
        f=tuple(tuple(row[::-1]) for row in cur)
        if f not in seen: seen.append(f)
        cur=rot90(cur)
    return seen

cells=[(4,10,12,18),(4,10,22,28),(4,10,35,41),(4,10,45,51),

       (22,28,12,18),(22,28,22,28),(22,28,35,41),(22,28,45,51)]
pal={i:dih(trim(win(L0,r0,r1,c0,c1))) for i,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in enumerate(cells,1)}
def match(g):
    t=trim(g); return [i for i in pal if t in pal[i]]
slots=[(14,20),(21,27),(28,34),(35,41),(42,48)]

    L=current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
    out=[]
    for c0,c1 in slots:

    return out
def cursor_slot():
    L=current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
    for i,(c0,c1) in enumerate(slots,1):
        if any(L[r][c]=='W' for r in (48,49) for c in range(c0,c1)): return i
    return None
def cycle_to(slot_idx, target, steps=7):
    for k in range(steps):
        action(['UP'])
        st=pink_states()
        print('slot%d after UP%d:'%(slot_idx,k+1), st)
        if st[slot_idx]==target: return True
        r=last_action_result
        if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over'): return 'STOP'
    return False

    r=cycle_to(2, 2)
    print('K3 done:', r)

        r=cycle_to(4, 6)
        print('K5 done:', r)

print('result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
